summary: Source constructs complete CSR row intervals and transfers inputs before timing. The grid covers ceil(numRows/256) blocks; each in-range thread owns one row, loops through all indices from rowDelimiters[row] to rowDelimiters[row+1], accumulates products, and stores output. Compiled main's requested-count backedge encloses the kernel launch, then calls cudaDeviceSynchronize before stopping the clock and copying results. The full final sm86 machine-code body includes the CSR interval loop, several retained full-chunk/remainder arithmetic paths, and the output store.
